name: digi-portal
description: Securely read administrator-approved DigiColony Work Portal items from the project bound to the current workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Bring approved Work Portal items into the correct workspace.
interface.longDescription: Digi-Portal verifies the workspace-to-project binding and provides read-only access to administrator-qualified queue items through OAuth-protected MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Verify this workspace's Digi-Portal binding and show the next agent-ready item.
Search the bound Work Items project for approved work related to this request.
